text:
Olivia Chen: Heads-up — planning a Private/VPC cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Need deploybot window, packaging sanity checks, and a short rollback plan. Target installer: v2026.03.20
Sahil Patel: +1. Can we limit canary to 5% and throttle deploybot to avoid saturating customer VPNs?
Deploy Bot: deploybot: preflight started for v2026.03.20. Image signatures present, manifests validated. /queue canary 5%
Marco Rivera: packaging: built tarball and shrinkwrap. Generated checksums and pushed to s3 private-bucket. Leaving md5 for legacy validators but primary is sha256.
Packaging Bot: checksums:
```
sha256sum redwood-installer-v2026.03.20.tar.gz
# output: d4c3b2...f1a9
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/pack-sign redwood-installer-v2026.03.20.tar.gz
# verified OK
```
Ops Oncall: FYI I'm oncall from 22:30–02:30 UTC. I'll watch deploy logs and PagerDuty. If we see >5% error-rate or repeated 5xx, we cut and rollback.
Jen Nguyen: Can we include a short release note blurb in the canary message? Ops needs the quick rollback steps and the release-note link.
Sahil Patel: Rollback plan: immediate rollback -> v2026.03.18 if canary error-rate >5% over a 10m window OR deploybot reports health-check failures on >2 distinct customers.
Marco Rivera: Confirming image pin: all nodes will fetch v2026.03.20; compatibility shim remains for v2026.03.18 for 48h. Also prepping smaller delta patch if we need hotfix.
Deploy Bot: rate-limit applied: 2 rps, burst 4. Canary schedule: start 23:00 UTC + monitor 15m, if green ramp to 25% over 30m, then full. Logs streamed to #eng-runtime.
Jen Nguyen: Release note (short): "Private installer v2026.03.20 — improves prefix cache handling and reduces memory in quantized runtimes. Hotfix rollback ready: v2026.03.18." Link: https://rt.redwood/release/2026-03-20
Olivia Chen: Quick checklist before go: 1) packaging checksum verified (Marco) 2) deploybot throttle set (Deploy Bot) 3) ops watching (Ops Oncall) 4) release note pushed (Jen). Anyone missing?
Marco Rivera: done on #1, uploaded attestations to signer and S3.
Deploy Bot: Canary job queued. Canary job id: cb-20260320-01. Health probes: /health, /metrics. Alerts: ping @Ops Oncall.
Ops Oncall: I'll be in the loop. If anything noisy between 23:00–23:30 I'll trigger rollback and post reason and trace ids.
Sahil Patel: Also ensure we don't inadvertently pin older connector images — double-check the bundle manifest before cutover.
Packaging Bot: manifest diff:
```
- connector-image: v2026.03.18
+ connector-image: v2026.03.20
```
Olivia Chen: Locking the window — deploybot runs in ~30m. Keep phones on. :shipit: 
Jen Nguyen: I'll post the public-facing snippet once canary passes initial 15m. :thumbsup:
